buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract

quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The work will be supervised by the Senior Section Engineer/Stores of Electric Loco Shed Royapur am. Chief Office Superintend/General/Office of Sr.DEE/RS/RPM will be the nodal agency to ensure t hat all Labour law provisions EPF, ESI, bonus etc., including the payment of minimum wages are pr ovided to contract personnel by Contractor. 2. All material, consumables, water, compressed air, tools, machinery and any other facility require d during the course of work will be provided by Railways. The contractor has to provide only manp ower to carry out the work. 3. The service provider has to provide 3 Mazdoor/Labour daily for carrying out Loading/Unloading of Loco equipments at Electric Loco Shed, Royapuram. If the service provider fails to provide stipulat ed manpower on any given day, a penalty of 0.5% of the monthly bill value of the particular manp ower per day, or a token penalty as decided by Sr.DEE/RS/RPM will be imposed. The penalty stipul ated here is in addition to the appropriate deduction of the amount (calculated on pro-rata basis) i n the monthly bill for the non-provision of stipulated manpower. 4. All personal protective equipment such as safety helmets, safety gloves, safety slings, safety sh oes, safety goggles etc. necessary for executing the subject work shall be provided by the service provider to his employees at the cost of the service provider. Also, the contractor shall take adequ ate steps to ensure the proper use of equipment by those concerned. The personal protective equ ipment are to be provided by the service provider at his own cost. 5. The work shall be carried out in day time i.e., between 06.00 Hours IST and 18.00 Hours IST nor mally on all working days. In case of any requirement/demand, the work shall be carried out beyo nd the aforesaid timings with prior approval from Sr.DEE/RS/RPM. The general working hours are fr om 8:00 Hours IST to 17:00 Hours IST with one hour rest. If there is any change in timings the sam e will be informed by the consignee and the service provider has to follow the same. If any employ ee is late to work beyond 30 minutes, the employee will not be allowed to duty and attendance of

the employee will be marked as absent. 6. The consignee will issue a daily job chart to the personnel of the service provider, they have to e nsure that the work is executed as mentioned in the daily job chart and as per specification for tha t day. If the work is not completed as per the daily job chart a penalty of Rs. 1000/- per instance o r a token penalty as decided by Sr.DEE/RS/RPM will be imposed. 7. If the service provider replaces/changes the personnel employed under this contract, the same s hall be communicated to the consignee. 8. Any misconduct/misbehavior on the part of the personnel deployed by the contractor under this c ontract will not be acceptable and such personnel will have to be replaced within a period of two d ays. In case such personnel is not replaced within the stipulated time from the third day the perso n will not be allowed for duty. 9. If any employee of the Service provider does not hold an identity card on any given day, a penalt y of Rs. 50/- per day per employee or a token penalty as decided by Sr.DEE/RS/RPM will be impose d. 10. If any employee of the Service provider does not wear a uniform on any given day, a penalty of R s.50/- per day per employee or a token penalty as decided by Sr.DEE/RS/RPM will be imposed. 11. The Service provider shall, prior to commencement of the work, submit to the office of Sr.DEE/RS/ RPM the complete list of personnel proposed to be deployed for execution of the contract, along wi th duly attested copies of their Aadhaar Cards and Police Verification Certificates. The Service prov ider shall further ensure that any subsequent addition, deletion, or replacement of personnel durin g the execution of the work is immediately reported, and the requisite documents for such person nel are submitted without delay. Under no circumstances shall any employee of the Service provid er be permitted to enter, remain, or work within the premises of ELS/RPM without prior completion of Police Verification and submission of Aadhaar Card copy, and without obtaining the necessary G ate Pass from the Competent Authority. The Contractor shall be solely responsible for adherence t o all statutory and security requirements in this regard. 12. The Service provider shall pay not less than the prevailing minimum wages prescribed by the Gov ernment of India Ministry of Labour & Employment from time to time during the currency of the co ntract. 13. It shall be the responsibility of the Service provider to ensure compliance with all Labour law provi sions EPF, ESI, bonus etc., including the payment of minimum wages, as declared by the Governm ent of India Ministry of Labour & Employment. The Service provider will be held wholly responsible for any action taken by statutory bodies for violation/non-compilation of any such provision/rule. 14. The Service provider shall pay wages to each of the personnel employed by him under this contra ct through the bank by 7th of each month for every completed previous month. The wages pay sli p shall be issued to all employees in the presence of the consignee. The Service provider shall pro vide proof of the wages paid, to the consignee. 15. The Service provider has to deposit the contribution of the employee as well as the employer tow ards EPF & ESI as per rules in force. Further, the Service provider while submitting their bill for pay ment shall also be responsible to submit documentary evidence of having submitted ESI and EPF amount (both contribution of employee and employer) in the respective account of the worker for the period for which bill is raised. 16. Shramik Kalyan : a) The Service provider is to abide by the provisions of various labour laws. In order to ensure t he same, an application has been developed and hosted on website www.shramikkalyan.indi anrailways.gov.in. The Service provider shall register his firm/company etc. and upload requis ite details of labour and their payment in this portal. These details shall be available in public domain. The Registration/ updation of Portal shall be done as under: I. The Service provider shall apply for onetime registration of his company/ firm etc. in the Shramikkalyan portal with requisite details subsequent to issue of L etter of Acceptance. Consignee shall approve the registration of Service provider i n the portal within 7 days of receipt of such request. II. The Service provider once approved by consignee, can create password

with login ID (PAN No.) for subsequent use of portal for all Letter of Acceptances (L oAs) issued in his favour. III. The Service provider once registered on the portal, shall provide details o f his Letter of Acceptances (LoAs)/Contract Agreements on shramikkalyan portal wi thin 15 days of issue of any LoA for approval of consignee. Consignee shall update (if required) and approve the details of LoA filled by the Service provider within 7 d ays of receipt of such request. IV. After approval of LoA by consignee, the Service provider shall fill the salie nt details of workmen engaged in the contract and ensure updating of each wage p ayment to them on shramikkalyan portal on monthly basis. V. It shall be mandatory upon the Service provider to ensure correct and pr ompt uploading of all salient details of engaged contractual labour & payments ma de thereof after each wage period. b) While processing payment of any On Account Bill or Final Bill or Performance Guarantee /Secur ity deposit, the Service provider shall submit a certificate to the consignee that I have uploaded the correct details of contract labours engaged in connection with this contract and payments made to them during the wage period in Shramikkalyan portal of Railway at www.shramikkalya n.indianrailways.gov.in till Month, Year. 17. SAFETY MEASURES: a) All personal protective equipment such as safety helmet, safety gloves, safety slings, safety shoes, safety goggles etc. necessary for executing the subject work shall be provide d by contractor to his employees at cost of contractor. Also, the contractor shall take adeq uate steps to ensure proper use of equipment by those concerned. The personal protectiv e equipment are to be provided by the contractor at his own cost. b) The Contractor shall take all pre-cautionary measures not only to ensure protection of his own personnel moving around or working on the Railway premises; but also conform to the rules and regulations of the Railways in this respect. Information about OHE, safe distance, movement of locos in yards, movement of material by crane are to be advised to the empl oyees of contractor provided under this contract with precautions to be taken and their ac knowledgement should be obtained by the contractor. c) The contractor shall warn all his workmen to be careful while crossing the tracks against t he movement of trains. The Railway accepts no claims in regard to any loss due to the acci dent on the track by the passage of trains. The Contractor shall also ensure that his workm en will observe strictly the Railway Safety Rules while he is on duty. d) The contractor shall warn strictly all his workmen not to climb to the roof of loco on any sit uation/condition without the knowledge of Sr. Section Engineer, Electric Loco Shed, Royapu ram. e) In case of accidents resulting in injury to the workmen of contractor, the contractor shall be liable for all compensation, insurance etc., for his workmen as per the various statutes a nd the Railway will have no bindings for such compensation. If the accident causes an injur y or a loss to the lives of the Railway employee/staff, the Railway administration shall have the right to claim any compensation on the contractor. f) The work must be carried out very carefully & adopt safe method of handling Railway ma terials without any infringement of the Indian Railways Act for the general and subsidiary r ules in force on the Railways in such a way that they do not hinder railway operation or not affect the proper functioning or cause damage to any railway equipment, structure or rolling stock except as agreed by the Railways. g) The contractor solely responsible for any loss or damages & Railway will not be responsib le for any loss during the accident by mis-handling of Railway Materials and shall bear the cost of all damages in cases of accidents/ unusual occurrences causing damages to Railwa y property. h) First aid facilities: The contractor shall provide and maintain a first aid box so as to be rea dily accessible for all his employees during all working hours.

18. The registers as indicated below shall be maintained by Coordinating supervisor of Consignee to carry out the subject work contract effectively I. Work progress register. 19. The contractor should maintain all the records and documents under various labour laws applica ble to contract labours/personnel and make them available at ELS/RPM at all times. Indicative list of such records is given for example: (a) Attendance register, (b) Wages register, (c) OT register e tc. 20. The work involved is purely on Contract basis and persons engaged by the contractor shall not be /deemed to be an employee of the Railway. 21. The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. 22. Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 23. While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and t he screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 24. The contractor shall submit a Joint Inspection Report/Attendance Sheet duly signed by both the C ontractor and the Railway, along with the Contractor’s invoice, GeM invoice, ESI and PF contributio n details, Aggregate Turnover Declaration, GSTR-2A, and the monthly wage report from the Shra mik Kalyan Portal, together with the bill. The bill shall not be processed on GeM unless all the abov e documents are submitted. 25. Delay in payment of the Contractor’s bill shall not, under any circumstances, be accepted as an e xcuse for failure to carry out the work satisfactorily or for non-payment of wages to the manpower deployed under the contract. 26. The service provider should originally belong to Tamil Nadu. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SU BMITTED. 27. The company, MSME or startup of the service provider should be registered in Tamil Nadu. DOCU MENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 28. AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 29. The geographical presence/address declared by the bidder shall be genuine, existing and verifiabl e. The Buyer reserves the right to verify the same at any stage from bid submission till completion of the contract by physical inspection, documentary verification or any other suitable means. If th e declared address is found to be non-existent, false, fictitious or unverifiable at any stage, the bid der shall be liable for disqualification/rejection of the bid. If detected after placement of order/awar d of contract, appropriate action including cancellation/termination of the contract shall be taken as per the applicable contractual provisions and rules. .
